Great Learning Academy, an online learning platform by Great Learning, offers a diverse range of high-quality, free courses and short-term professional courses with certificates across various domains, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, IT & Software, Business, Digital Marketing, and more.


Designed and delivered by leading industry experts and experienced instructors, these programs provide a comprehensive and high-quality learning experience, equipping professionals and students with the skills needed to excel in their respective fields.

What is the difference between Pro Courses and Free Courses?

Pro courses are short professional courses that offer advanced-level learning experience, featuring AI-powered mentorship, hands-on projects, coding exercises, and a certificate of completion.

Our free online courses offer foundational knowledge with optional certificates for a fee, enabling you to get started with key concepts and gain valuable insights. However, they don’t include advanced features such as personalized mentorship or hands-on projects.

If you're looking for an introduction to a topic, the free courses are perfect; if you want a more in-depth, guided experience, you can explore our Pro courses.

What are Pro Courses?

Pro courses are an advanced version of online free courses designed to provide in-depth knowledge in various fields. These courses include personalized AI-driven mentorship, hands-on projects, and real-world experience to help you master essential skills and earn a certificate of completion.

These courses are best for anyone who wants to acquire specialized skills and industry-recognized certificates to stand out in the competitive job market.

How does the certification course help in career advancement?

By completing a free course on Great Learning, you'll earn a certificate and gain practical skills that you can apply in your job, boosting your productivity and efficiency. The certificate serves as proof of your dedication to personal development, helping you stand out in a competitive job market. While certification alone isn’t a guarantee for career advancement, it significantly strengthens your resume and can open doors to new opportunities.

How can I enroll in these courses?

To enroll in a free course, simply visit the Great Learning Academy website and browse through the courses available. Choose a course that interests you, then sign up using your Google account or email address. Once enrolled, you can begin learning immediately. If you already have an account, just log in and start your course.

How long are the free courses at Great Learning Academy?

The duration of the free online courses varies based on the course content and complexity. Most courses can be completed in a few hours to a few days, while more comprehensive Pro courses may take a few weeks. You can check the estimated completion time for each course page.



Are there any prerequisites to enroll in these free courses?

No, there are no prerequisites to enroll in Great Learning Academy’s free courses. Whether you're a beginner or have some prior experience, you can start learning right away. For some technical topics, it may help to know a programming language, but even if you don’t, we offer free courses to help you learn programming before you dive into those advanced topics. Our courses are designed to accommodate learners from all backgrounds.

Is there any time duration for completing these courses?

All the free courses are self-paced. You can complete them at your convenience.

Do I need any skills or experience to enroll in these free courses?

No, there are no prerequisites to enroll in Great Learning Academy courses. Anyone can join, regardless of their background or experience level.

What are my next learning opportunities after completing any of the online courses?

Once you complete a free course, you can explore professional programs offered in partnership with top global universities. These programs are taught by university faculty and industry experts and provide advanced learning opportunities that will help you further your career. You'll receive mentorship and develop a deep understanding of your chosen field, ensuring you're ready for the next step in your professional journey.
